notes.title: Korea Game Expo [2025 PlayX4] - Hayo and the Emporium is joining the show!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602805/7bfb81623b3f755fa921ddbb6de6c9b2765f17ea.png[/img]

Let’s make a game full of cuteness and curiosity!
Hello! We’re CatDoors.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602805/a58403edc1cfa5d7545403ea8e62a662530f5a5f.png[/img]
We’re excited to announce that <Hayo and the Emporium> will be showcased at the 2025 PlayX4 Game Expo!

• Dates: May 22 – May 25, 2025
• Location: KINTEX Exhibition Center 1, Hall 5 (BTB), FGT Zone & Free Play Zone, Ilsanseo-gu, Goyang-si, Gyeonggi-do, South Korea



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602805/90391c1324d85b59275575d913aad1e328232f8e.png[/img]
At this event, you’ll be able to play a new demo version of the game featuring improvements based on feedback we received at Illustar Fest.
We’ll also be conducting a playtest survey at the FGT Zone, we’d love to hear your thoughts!

We hope you’ll stop by and enjoy <Hayo and the Emporium> with us.
Your interest and support mean a great deal to us.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Illustar Fes, Korea] Thank You for Our First Demo Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602805/7bfb81623b3f755fa921ddbb6de6c9b2765f17ea.png[/img]

Let’s make a game full of cuteness and curiosity!
Hello! We’re CatDoors.

We had the very first offline showcase of our game, Hayo and the Emporium, even before the demo was publicly released!

With a mix of nerves and excitement, we set up our booth.
To our surprise, so many people stopped by, tried out the game,
and shared their warm encouragement and valuable feedback.

Thanks to your support, our whole team gained a lot of energy,
and it gave us a great opportunity to reflect on the direction of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602805/d3dd57a20b0266ffd15bf51abd5774cbb2a32824.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602805/1ddc751cff42ccd81942e904915308dec005c388.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602805/13c67cb141dd6dd035941a23b7a184539eed81c5.jpg[/img]
A heartfelt thank you to everyone who visited us!
We’ll keep working hard to bring you an even better experience.

Thank you so much for all the love and support!
